evidence_items.claim: Deutsche Bank participated in the FINOS Legend Studio 6-month pilot (2020-2021) to prototype interbank collaborative data modeling, specifically to build FX Options extensions to the CDM
evidence_items.excerpt: Leading investment banks including Deutsche Bank, Morgan Stanley and RBC Capital Markets participated in a six-month pilot using a shared version of Legend, hosted on FINOS infrastructure in the public cloud, to prototype interbank collaborative data modeling and standardization, particularly to build extensions to the Common Domain Model (CDM).
evidence_items.caveats: Pilot from 2020-2021. Historical evidence (>3 years old). Need to verify continued engagement.
evidence_items.named_individual: Russell Green, MD, Head of Group Architecture

evidence_items.claim: Deutsche Bank's FX Options extensions (specifically the Averaging Model) from the Legend pilot were proposed into the CDM, accepted, and integrated into a public CDM release
evidence_items.excerpt: The FX option extensions, specifically the Averaging Model used in the CDM, modeled collaboratively by the pilot group financial institutions participants using Legend, were proposed into the CDM and have since been accepted, released and integrated into a recent release to the public.
evidence_items.caveats: Contribution from 2021. One-time contribution without evidence of sustained engagement.

evidence_items.claim: Russell Green (MD, Head of Group Architecture) elected as FINOS Board Vice Chairman in August 2021, advocating for CDM and data modeling collaboration
evidence_items.excerpt: John Madsen, chief architect for technology at Goldman Sachs, became FINOS board chairman and Russell Green, head of cloud architecture at Deutsche Bank, became the new vice chairman.
evidence_items.caveats: FINOS board role indicates governance engagement. Does not confirm CDM production usage.
evidence_items.named_individual: Russell Green, MD, Head of Cloud Architecture

evidence_items.claim: Deutsche Bank participated in the Kaizen Regulatory Reporting 2024 conference alongside ISDA and other industry experts, discussing EMIR Refit and regulatory reporting topics (but no CDM-specific content)
evidence_items.excerpt: Kaizen Reporting hosted their annual regulatory reporting conference welcoming more than 200 clients, with panellists including representatives from the ISDA, FIA, Regis-TR, BMO, HSBC, Deutsche Bank, ABRDN and other industry experts.
evidence_items.caveats: General regulatory reporting engagement. No CDM-specific content mentioned. Indicates compliance focus but not CDM adoption.
